abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one LockLearn instance is supported.

dataset_discovery_failed.title: Dataset catalog unavailable
dataset_discovery_failed.description: LockLearn could not check available versions for {dataset_id}. Already installed content remains usable offline.

dataset_install_failed.title: Dataset update failed
dataset_install_failed.description: The update of {dataset_id} failed during download, verification, or activation. The last valid generation remains active.

dataset_sources_stale.title: Dataset sources are stale
dataset_sources_stale.description: The sources {sources} used by {dataset_id} exceed their freshness target. The installed dataset remains usable, but an update is recommended.

scheduler_configuration_infeasible.title: Scheduler capacity is insufficient
scheduler_configuration_infeasible.description: Profile {profile_id} requests {requested} daily notification slots but only {capacity} are currently allocatable. Adjust Track demand, target budgets, or scheduler windows.

notification_target_unavailable.title: Notification target unavailable
notification_target_unavailable.description: LockLearn cannot currently resolve or deliver to {friendly_name} ({target_id}). The notification was not recorded as sent.

state_integrity_failure.title: LockLearn user state needs recovery
state_integrity_failure.description: LockLearn did not open its state writer because state.db failed integrity validation. {snapshot_count} validated recovery snapshot(s) are currently available. Open the LockLearn integration options to inspect storage and explicitly restore a snapshot. LockLearn will never overwrite the only user-state copy automatically.

init.title: Storage, backup and recovery
init.description: Persistent state: {state_size}. Reconstructible content cache: {content_cache_size}, including assets: {asset_size}. Recovery snapshots: {recovery_size} ({snapshot_count} available). On the Home Assistant 2025.2 compatibility floor the reconstructible content cache is included in HA backups; LockLearn checkpoints and snapshots state coherently before the archive is created. Choose what LockLearn may delete if the Config Entry is later removed. Restoring a snapshot is explicit and preserves the current live files in a bounded quarantine first.

data.uninstall_data_policy: Data policy when LockLearn is removed
data.restore_snapshot: Restore a validated recovery snapshot now
data.purge_content_cache: Purge the reconstructible content cache now and rebuild it

error.storage_unload_failed: LockLearn could not unload safely. No storage action was performed.
error.storage_action_failed: The requested storage action failed. The existing data was preserved or rolled back.
error.storage_reload_failed: The storage action completed, but LockLearn could not reload. Check the Repair before continuing.
